description: This file defines a Flutter widget implementing a TV-friendly on-screen keyboard, including a static method to show it as a modal dialog, with focus management and custom key layout for D-Pad navigation.

classes.name: OnScreenKeyboard
classes.description: A StatefulWidget providing a full-screen on-screen keyboard designed for TV navigation with DPAD, including methods to show it as a dialog.

classes.name: _OnScreenKeyboardState
classes.description: State class managing internal buffer, focus nodes, key layout, and user interactions.

classes.name: _KeySpec
classes.description: Model class representing individual keys, including character keys and action keys (Space, Backspace, Done, Cancel, etc.)

methods.name: show
methods.description: Static method to present the keyboard as a modal dialog and return the entered string or null.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for OnScreenKeyboard widget.

methods.name: _buildKeys
methods.description: Builds the list of key specifications for the keyboard layout.

methods.name: _notifyChanged
methods.description: Calls onChanged callback with current buffer.

methods.name: _append
methods.description: Appends a character to the buffer.

methods.name: _backspace
methods.description: Removes the last character from the buffer.

methods.name: _space
methods.description: Inserts a space character into the buffer.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Invokes onSubmitted callback with current buffer.

methods.name: _cancel
methods.description: Invokes onCancelled callback, typically to dismiss without submitting.

methods.name: _handleBack
methods.description: Handles back/escape key events to trigger cancel.

methods.name: _previewText
methods.description: Returns the buffer content, possibly obscured if obscurePreview is true.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the keyboard, including layout, focus management, and key widgets.

methods.name: _activateKey
methods.description: Handles action when a key is pressed: appends characters or triggers actions like backspace, done, or cancel.
